body.zh-Hant: 豐田副武是日本海軍大將，1885年5月22日生於大分縣，畢業於海軍兵學校與海軍大學校。他在大正15年任由良艦長，昭和5年任日向艦長，8年任連合艦隊參謀長，10年任軍務局長，14年任艦政本部長，其間曾駐在英國。
body.en: Toyoda Soemu was an Imperial Japanese Navy admiral, born on 22 May 1885 in Oita Prefecture, and a graduate of the Naval Academy and the Naval War College. He captained the Yura in Taisho 15 and the Hyuga in Showa 5, became chief of staff of the Combined Fleet in Showa 8, director of the Naval Affairs Bureau in Showa 10 and head of the Naval Ship Bureau in Showa 14, after a posting in Britain.

citations.quote: 海軍軍人（大将）。大分県生まれ。海軍兵学校、海軍大学校卒業

heading.en: Admiral, district commander and Combined Fleet commander

body.zh-Hant: 1941年他晉升大將，出任吳鎮守府司令長官。1944年古賀峯一大將殉職後，他於同年5月接任第3代連合艦隊司令長官，同年10月指揮雷伊泰灣海戰（レイテ沖海戦）；20世紀日本人名事典評該次指揮為失敗。
body.en: In 1941 he was promoted to full admiral and became commander of the Kure Naval District. After Admiral Koga Mineichi died in 1944, he took over as the third commander-in-chief of the Combined Fleet in May that year and in October commanded the naval battle off Leyte; the Nijusseiki Nihonjin Meiji Jiten calls his command a failure.

heading.en: Chief of the Naval General Staff and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月他成為最後的軍令部長（軍令部總長），在御前會議上反對接受波茨坦宣言，主張徹底抗戰，但主張未能實現。戰敗後他以戰犯被收容，1948年獲釋，1949年被判無罪；著有1950年出版的《最後の帝国海軍》，1957年9月22日去世。
body.en: In May 1945 he became the last chief of the Naval General Staff; at the Imperial Conference he opposed accepting the Potsdam Declaration and argued for resistance to the end, though his plan was not carried out. After the defeat he was held as a war criminal, released in 1948 and acquitted in 1949; he wrote Saigo no Teikoku Kaigun (1950) and died on 22 September 1957.

body.zh-Hant: 阿南惟幾為日本陸軍大將，1887年2月21日生，1905年11月自陸軍士官學校（第18期）畢業，1918年11月自陸軍大學校畢業。他在昭和4年8月任侍從武官，5年8月升大佐，8年8月任近衛步兵第2聯隊長，9年8月任東京陸軍幼年學校長，11年8月任兵務局長，12年3月任人事局長。
body.en: Anami Korechika was an Imperial Japanese Army general, born on 21 February 1887; he graduated from the Army Academy (18th class) in November 1905 and from the Army War College in November 1918. He became imperial aide-de-camp in August Showa 4, colonel in August Showa 5, commander of the 2nd Imperial Guard Infantry Regiment in August Showa 8, head of the Tokyo Army Cadet School in August Showa 9, director of the Military Affairs Bureau in August Showa 11 and head of the Personnel Bureau in March Showa 12.

citations.quote: 生年月日明治20年2月21日
明治38年11月陸軍士官学校卒業(18期)、大正7年11月陸軍大学校卒業(30期)
昭和4年8月侍従武官、5年8月大佐、8年8月近衛歩兵第2連隊長、9年8月東京陸軍幼年学校長
11年8月兵務局長、12年3月人事局長

heading.zh-Hant: 師團長、次官與方面軍司令官

body.zh-Hant: 1938年11月他任第109師團長，在中國山西省指揮戰鬥；1939年10月至1941年4月任陸軍次官，參與以國家總動員體制為中心的戰時國策制定。1941年4月任第11軍司令官，1942年7月任第2方面軍司令官，在中國大陸與澳洲北部（北豪州）指揮作戰，1943年5月晉升大將，1944年12月任航空總監兼航空本部長。
body.en: In November 1938 he became commander of the 109th Division and led fighting in Shanxi Province, China. He was vice-minister of the army from October 1939 to April 1941, helping shape wartime policy centred on the national mobilisation system. He commanded the 11th Army from April 1941 and the 2nd Area Army from July 1942, directing operations in mainland China and northern Australia, was promoted to full general in May 1943 and became Inspector General of Aviation and head of the Army Aviation Headquarters in December 1944.

citations.quote: 1938年（昭和13）11月、第一〇九師団長となり、中国山西(さんせい／シャンシー)省で戦闘を指揮した

body.zh-Hant: 1945年4月他任陸軍大臣，主張本土決戰；防衛研究所頁面稱他倡導本土決戰與徹底的水際擊滅論。8月的御前會議上他表明反對接受波茨坦宣言；聖斷決定無條件投降後，他在8月15日拂曉自刃，留有「一死以テ大罪ヲ謝シ奉ル」遺書。
body.en: He became Army Minister in April 1945 and advocated a decisive battle on the home islands; the National Institute for Defense Studies describes him as championing homeland decisive battle and annihilation at the water's edge. He voiced opposition to accepting the Potsdam Declaration at the Imperial Conference in August; after the Emperor's decision for unconditional surrender he killed himself at dawn on 15 August, leaving a note reading "Isshi motte taizai o shashi tatematsuru".

body.zh-Hant: 何應欽字敬之，貴州興義人，1890年4月2日生（日本大百科全書則寫1889年）。他畢業於日本陸軍士官學校第11期，留學期間加入中國革命同盟會，參加辛亥革命與第二革命。
body.en: He Yingqin, courtesy name Jingzhi, was a native of Xingyi in Guizhou, born on 2 April 1890 (the Nipponica gives 1889). He graduated from the Imperial Japanese Army Academy (11th class), joined the Chinese Revolutionary Alliance while studying in Japan, and took part in the 1911 Revolution and the Second Revolution.

citations.quote: 字は敬之
日本陸軍士官学校 11期卒業。留学中，中国革命同盟会に加入し辛亥革命，第二革命に参加

heading.en: Whampoa, the Northern Expedition and North China

body.zh-Hant: 1924年他任黃埔陸軍軍官學校教頭（教務主任），其後在北伐中任國民革命軍第一軍團長並歷任參謀長，輔佐蔣介石。1933年3月12日國民政府明令派他任北平軍分會代理委員長；1935年他與日方簽訂梅津—何應欽協定，被日本大百科全書認為助長日軍對華北的支配。
body.en: In 1924 he became chief instructor (director of instruction) at the Whampoa Military Academy, and in the Northern Expedition he commanded the First Army Corps of the National Revolutionary Army and served as chief of staff, assisting Chiang Kai-shek. On 12 March 1933 the Nationalist government appointed him acting chairman of the Beiping branch of the Military Commission, and in 1935 he concluded the Umezu–He Yingqin Agreement with Japan, which the Nipponica says helped Japan's control of North China.

heading.zh-Hant: 軍政部長、陸軍總司令與戰後
heading.en: War Minister, Army Commander-in-Chief and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 他曾任軍政部長與參謀總長。1944年戰局不利，陳誠接替他出任軍政部長；同年12月25日陸軍總司令部在昆明成立，何應欽任總司令。1945年9月9日他呈蔣中正簽呈，報告中國戰區日軍正式投降儀式的時間與地點。戰後他任國防部長（1948年）與行政院長（1949年），後因上海失陷辭職。
body.en: He served as Minister of War and as Chief of the General Staff. When the war went badly in 1944 Chen Cheng replaced him as War Minister, and on 25 December the Army General Headquarters was established at Kunming with He Yingqin as commander-in-chief. On 9 September 1945 he submitted a report to Chiang Kai-shek on the time and place of the formal Japanese surrender ceremony in the China Theater. After the war he was Minister of National Defense (1948) and President of the Executive Yuan (1949), resigning after the fall of Shanghai.

body.zh-Hant: 何應欽字敬之，貴州興義人，1890年4月2日生（日本大百科全書則寫1889年）。他畢業於日本陸軍士官學校第11期，留學期間加入中國革命同盟會，參加辛亥革命與第二革命。
body.en: He Yingqin, courtesy name Jingzhi, was a native of Xingyi in Guizhou, born on 2 April 1890 (the Nipponica gives 1889). He graduated from the Imperial Japanese Army Academy (11th class), joined the Chinese Revolutionary Alliance while studying in Japan, and took part in the 1911 Revolution and the Second Revolution.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年10月，余漢謀任廣東綏靖公署主任與第十二集團軍總司令，所部是廣州附近國軍的主力，下轄3軍7師。10月12日日軍在廣東大亞灣附近強行登陸，21日攻占廣州；國軍敗退過速，余漢謀被人責難，時有「鐵城無城，漢謀無謀」之說。
body.en: In October 1938 Yu Hanmou was director of the Guangdong Pacification Office and commander-in-chief of the 12th Army Group, whose forces were the main Chinese strength near Guangzhou, with 3 armies and 7 divisions. Japanese forces landed by force near Daya Bay on 12 October and took Guangzhou on 21 October; the Chinese retreat was too rapid, Yu was blamed, and the saying "Tiecheng has no city, Hanmou has no plan" arose.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年11月，日軍沿粵漢鐵路向北進攻，發動翁英（翁源、英德）作戰；廣東國軍奉令發動冬季攻勢，於11月27日起以余漢謀的第十二集團軍為主力向日軍進攻。1940年1月1日起日軍分路南退，國軍轉敗為勝，號稱「粵北大捷」，但該文指出此役國軍遺棄倉庫輜重，損失甚鉅。
body.en: In November 1939 Japanese forces advanced north along the Guangzhou–Hankou railway in the Wengying (Wengyuan–Yingde) operation; Chinese troops in Guangdong were ordered to launch a winter offensive and from 27 November attacked with Yu Hanmou's 12th Army Group as the main force. From 1 January 1940 the Japanese withdrew south in several columns and the Chinese turned defeat into victory, called the "Great Victory in Northern Guangdong", although the source notes that the Chinese abandoned depots and supplies and suffered heavy losses.

body.zh-Hant: 抗戰結束受降時，國史館刊載的《中國受降區域及受降主官表》把「曲江潮汕地區」的受降主官列為第七戰區司令長官余漢謀，日方受降軍官為田中久一，可見余漢謀當時是第七戰區司令長官。
